title: General Muellner's retirement-day interview on Aurora

tellings.quote: with a guy called General George Moina who was the US Air Force's head of research and development until his retirement in 1998.

plain: Nick Cook, a writer on military aviation who made a documentary called Billion Dollar Secret, says he interviewed General George Muellner, the US Air Force's head of research and development, on the day he retired in 1998. Cook says he asked him about Aurora, a rumoured secret American aircraft, hoping a general on his last day might speak more freely about what the military was really flying.
